name: zinc finger and BTB domain containing 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ZBTB2 encodes zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of cytokine production.
